definitions.gloss: shoddy goods; inferior product; low-grade article
definitions.explanation: A product made badly or from poor materials, often sold cheaply or passed off as better than it is. Stronger and more critical than {安物|やすもの} (cheap item).

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{粗悪品|そあくひん}だ。
{安|やす}すぎる⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{粗悪品|そあくひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Among products that are too cheap, many are shoddy.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{充電器|じゅうでんき}→充電器：05106_juudenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{粗悪品|そあくひん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}えなく→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The charger I bought online was a shoddy product and soon stopped working.

notes:
From ⟦{粗悪|そあく}→粗悪：18175_soaku⟧ (crude, inferior) and 〜⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (goods). Common in news about counterfeit or unsafe products.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粗悪品|そあくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかまされる: to be stuck with shoddy goods
- {粗悪品|そあくひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出回|でまわ}る→出回る：11736_demawaru⟧: shoddy goods are on the market
- {粗悪品|そあくひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to watch out for inferior products

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不良品|ふりょうひん}→不良品：19452_furyouhin⟧: defective product — a faulty unit that should have been fine
- ⟦{安物|やすもの}→安物：22116_yasumono⟧: cheap item — cheapness first, poor quality implied
